result.document_summary: A mid-document slice of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Government) covering design-build procurement (Div. 34) and nondiscrimination in city contracting (Div. 35), mislabeled by its URL as the rent-price-fixing section.
result.notes: No rule in the six residential-rental categories appears in this part. The text covers municipal design-build procurement agreements, prequalification and selection methods, and nondiscrimination in city contracting. Despite the source URL naming San Diego's ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices (Division 11, § 98.1103), the retrieved text does not contain that provision, so nothing was extracted.
